definitions.at_break_even: rho, sigma(log a0) and cond are evaluated at y_max_break_even (the stable one); at_first is the same at y_max_first
definitions.cond: ratio of the eigenvalues of F (raw); cond_normalised = (1+|rho|)/(1-|rho|)
definitions.design: N points, y_i = y_min (y_max/y_min)^((i-1)/(N-1)) (log-uniform, endpoints included)
definitions.kernels: P2: nu = sqrt(1+1/y), b = 1/(2(1+y)); nu_mono: nu = 1/(1-exp(-sqrt y)), b = s/(2(e^s-1)), s = sqrt(y)
definitions.law: g_obs = (f g) nu((f g)/a0), one multiplicative calibration f on g_bar, same f and a0 at every point
definitions.rho: correlation of the estimates of (log10 f, log10 a0) = -F12/sqrt(F11 F22); NEGATIVE in every cell (both parameters raise g_obs, degenerate direction f*a0 fixed)
definitions.sigma_log_a0: marginal sigma of log10 a0 = sqrt((F^-1)_22), f free (with the Gaussian prior on log10 f when prior_log_f_dex is not null)
definitions.y: y = f g_bar / a0 at the TRUE (f, a0): the argument fed to nu; y_nom = g_bar/a0 = y/f.
definitions.y_max_break_even: smallest grid y_max such that sigma(log a0) < 0.1 dex for ALL larger grid y_max up to the cap (null = never within the cap); y_max_first = smallest grid y_max with sigma < 0.1
definitions.y_max_grid: y_min * 10^(k/50), k = 1.. up to the cap

ladder.T4_floor: sigma(log a0) >= 3 sigma/sqrt(N) for any sample (f free)
